messages.subject: SPDE in INLA
parts: I made myself an implemention of SPDE methodology following the work of Lindgren et al . (2011), i get the precision matrix but i don't kow how use it in INLA.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: SPDE in INLA
parts:
Hi!
Using you own precision matrix in INLA is not really possible (if it depends on any parameters).  However, the SPDE models are (partially) implemented already.  See the case study
http://www.r-inla.org/examples/case-studies/lindgren-rue-and-lindstrom-rss-paper-2011
for an example of how to use the basic initial interface, that handles Matern fields with nu=1 (alpha=2).  I am currently working on an improved interface.

Let me know if you have a specific SPDE model that you would like to use, so that we might incorporate that in our ongoing implementation work.

/Finn
